description: The image taxonomy, as zero-shot prompts. A class with several prompts is represented by their average. Prompts are lowercased before use.

packshot.description: The device on a plain background.
prompts: a product photo of a device on a plain white background

in_situ.description: The device installed or in use.
prompts: a smart home device installed in a room
the retail packaging box of an electronic device

label.description: A label or nameplate with model or regulatory details.
prompts: a close-up of a product label with a model number

internals.description: The circuit board or inside of the device.
prompts: the inside of an electronic device showing its circuit board

screenshot.description: An app or web interface for the device.
prompts: a screenshot of a phone app

unrelated.description: Anything that doesn't show the device.
prompts: a photo of an animal, plant or landscape
